overviewHtml:
Compliance findings for Kubernetes workloads pile up, and security and platform teams spend time triaging them one by one.

What you get

  • A DQL query every three hours for critical and high workload misconfigurations
  • Optional filtering to a single cluster
  • A sub-workflow started per finding with the object, type, title, occurrences and compliance control
  • A hook for an agent that suggests or applies fixes
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows
  • Security posture management / compliance findings for Kubernetes in Grail
  • A sub-workflow that processes one finding, for example an agentic AI workflow that suggests Kubernetes fixes. It isn't included here.
setupHtml:
1. Download trigger-kubernetes-operations-agent.workflow-template.yaml and upload it in Workflows.
  2. In suggest_k8s_fixes, select the sub-workflow that should handle each finding (workflowId).
  3. Run it once manually, then activate the schedule. It's inactive by default.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, Kubernetes compliance findings in Grail and a sub-workflow that handles one finding.

  1. Upload the workflow template in Workflows
  2. Select the sub-workflow that handles each finding
  3. Run once manually, then activate the schedule
